profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. The company describes itself as providing a "Revenue AI OS," a platform it positions as serving go-to-market organizations through what it calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built sales applications. Its stated capabilities include deal coaching, pipeline risk prediction, automated handoffs, and customer success tooling aimed at reducing churn and driving expansion.

Gong's core product, categorized as a notes, knowledge, and meetings tool, centers on revenue intelligence AI with call analysis and deal coaching functions. The company also offers named products including Gong Engage, described as a sales engagement tool for prioritizing and personalizing outreach, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer feature the company says grounds sales training in recorded customer conversations. One quoted customer claims Gong saved 6,700 hours across call preparation, follow-up, and CRM updates, and that its AI Tracker agent helped lift buyer response rates by 32%.

The held facts note that Gong carries notable legal exposure, with 174 cases linked to California, which is consistent with the sensitivity flags the site itself acknowledges around sales data privacy and responsible AI governance. No SEC filings or patents are recorded in the available data. Three MCP server entries appear under the Gong name in the registry, two focused on SQLite database exploration and one unrelated options-income tool, suggesting mixed registry association rather than official Gong-published servers.
